name: yuanbao_encode_forward_msg_data
notes: Links the REAL port incl. static nested-message encoders. Inputs always carry a numeric sub_type because LIVE defaults a missing key to 0 (emitting field 1) while the port skips the field when the key is absent — documented divergence outside the gated surface. Value event carries the full hex of the encoded protobuf so any wire-format drift fails.
